subject: Mobile Development
title: Hybrid Apps: The Middle Ground
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Hybrid Apps: The Middle Ground.

hook.text: Building separate apps for iOS and Android costs twice as much. Hybrid apps cut that cost.

buildup.text: Frameworks like React Native and Flutter let developers write once and run on both platforms.

discovery.text: Hybrid apps use a shared codebase but compile to native components for each platform.

twist.text: Performance is close to native but not identical. Complex animations can stutter.

climax.text: Most startups choose hybrid to ship faster. Most tech giants build fully native.

punchline.text: One codebase, two platforms, some tradeoffs.

quiz.question: What do hybrid app frameworks allow?
options: Writing code once for both iOS and Android
